58:t_015:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Leave keeping an eye on that one to $$ガロード$$! We're going after that $$ギルター$$ character!」

58:t_015:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Him...! He attacked the fleet out of spite because we made a fool of him!」

58:t_015:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「Ugh, I can't stand that obsessive type.」

58:t_015:3.en:
$n
「Then let's beat him so hard he won't even feel like holding a grudge.」

58:t_015:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Whoa... You're really in your element, $n.」

58:t_015:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn it! Defying me... What thoroughly unpleasant wretches!」

58:t_015:7.en:
$n
「Still better than a guy who plays dirty and drags civilians into it.」

58:t_015:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Get ready, $$ギルター$$! You're not getting away today!」

58:t_016:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn it! Forces we never anticipated have shown up today! We're falling back!」

58:t_016:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Like I'll let you get away, $$ギルター$$!」

58:t_016:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「If it comes to this, all that's left is to throw in the reserve forces too!」

58:t_017:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You lot, hold them off! That's an order!」

58:t_018:0.en:
$$海賊$$
「You want us to be the rear guard in this situation...!?」

58:t_018:1.en:
$$海賊$$
「If I'd known it'd come to this, I should've stayed under $$ラケージ$$...」

58:t_018:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm not gonna shoot someone who doesn't want to fight.」

58:t_018:7.en:
$$海賊$$
「We'll never lay a hand on your fleet again! I promise!」

58:t_018:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Enemy unit's withdrawal action confirmed.]

58:t_020:2.en:
$$海賊$$
「I don't know what's going on, but I'm clearing out!」

58:t_021:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Those guys didn't want to fight...! What good does it do to shoot someone like that!?」

58:t_021:2.en:
$$レド$$
[What is this guy talking about?]

58:t_021:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The individual is objecting to the annihilation of hostile forces.]

58:t_021:4.en:
$$レド$$
[I can't understand it at all. Then the fighting would never end, would it?]

58:t_021:6.en:
$$レド$$
[It's an allied unit, but its pilot must be a local.]

58:t_021:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Requesting instructions for action.]

58:t_021:8.en:
$$レド$$
[Continuing this standoff isn't the wisest move, but we can't act together with them either. We'll operate independently.]

58:t_022:0.en:
$$パーラ$$
「What the heck is with that one...」

58:t_022:1.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「That jerk... Are they planning to squat over there for good?」

58:t_023:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Enemy units have broken through the first line of defense!」

58:t_023:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They are still some distance from the fleet. All units, stay calm and deal with them.」

58:t_100:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The $$ガルガンティア船団$$ took us in when we had nowhere to go...!」

58:t_100:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Come on, then, $$サイデリアル$$! As long as I'm here, I'll protect the fleet no matter what!」

58:t_101:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sending your men in head-on while you pull a sneak attack yourself...! What a lame guy!」

58:t_101:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Silence...! Every bit of it is a tactic necessary for victory!」

58:t_101:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Too bad! You'll never get that victory! Not as long as we're here!」

58:t_102:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「If all you do is pull cheap tricks, your fine commander unit's gonna cry!」

58:t_102:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Hmph... It seems you're another simpleton who favors brute-force tactics.」

58:t_102:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I prize efficiency. The plan exists for that very purpose, barbarian.」

58:t_102:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「You use your men and the pirates as disposable pawns, and you call that efficient!?」

58:t_102:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「A coward like you has no right to talk big!!」

58:t_103:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I see that unit is built for land combat...! It's a pity, but however excellent a soldier you may be, against this situation and my plan...」

58:t_103:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Remember this, $$アル$$. What fate awaits a soldier who wastes words on the battlefield.」

58:t_103:2.en:
$$アル$$
「Understood. Seeing such an unseemly display, I shall consider exercising a bit more restraint myself.」

58:t_104:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Using nothing but dirty tricks...! Guys like that are bound to be hopeless in a real fight!」

58:t_104:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Brat! An opponent like you doesn't even require a plan!」

58:t_104:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What are you talking about! All your plans have failed, so the only thing left for you is to fight head-on!」

58:t_104:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You little brat! I've let you run your mouth long enough...!」

58:t_104:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you can only hold your own against an elementary schooler like me in a squabble, your brains can't be much either!」

58:t_105:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Go, $$鉄人$$! Stop him before he gets to pull any more dirty tricks!」

58:t_105:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Hmph... Don't think I'm a man of nothing but strategy. Even fighting head-on, the likes of you won't get the better of me!」

58:t_105:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I won't listen to a villain's bluster! If you're that confident, stop using dirty tricks!!」

58:t_106:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You came with dirty tricks again this time! You're a coward down to your core!」

58:t_106:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh heh... Those cries of resentment from my enemies are the highest praise I could ask for.」

58:t_106:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Is that so! I'm used to dealing with sneaky types like that!」

58:t_106:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「A guy like this gets hammered until he never wants to fight again!」

58:t_107:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Dirty tricks last time and again today...! Have you no shame!」

58:t_107:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Naive, woman! Winning is all that matters in battle! And on top of that, I demand efficiency!」

58:t_107:4.en:
$n
「If you want to end a battle in the fewest moves, you concentrate your aim on the commander...」

58:t_107:6.en:
$n
「That's the idea, $$ギルター$$...! Time to crush you, and fast!」

58:t_108:0.en:
$$レド$$
[Crushing that group's hostile force will tilt future negotiations in our favor... To that end, we need to show them what we can do.]
